subject: PO field mapping, net terms & conditional discount request
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@greenarc.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenarc.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO field mapping, net terms & conditional discount request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profiles and the rollout options. Procurement asked me to consolidate a few billing items so we can push a blanket PO through our ERP. Can you confirm the following so we can format the PO correctly?

- Required PO fields (we typically need: PO number, bill_to name, remit_to address, BU code, cost center)
- Whether you support line-item SKUs in the PO vs a single blanket PO reference
- Invoice cadence: do you support monthly invoices against a blanket PO, or do you require an invoice per billing event?
- Net terms: our default is Net45; we have some partners on Net60. Any flexibility for Net30/Net45/Net60?

One more ask on commercials: if we commit to an annual spend and prepay 12 months upfront, would Redwood consider a committed-volume discount? If so, what thresholds and rough % ranges do you offer?

I attached our standard PO template for reference (GreenArc_PO_78921.pdf). If it's easier, we can hop on a short call.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Sr. Procurement Manager
GreenArc Systems
procurement@greenarc.com

Attachments: GreenArc_PO_78921.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@greenarc.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field mapping, net terms & conditional discount request

Hi Elena — great to hear and thanks for sending the PO template. Quick answers below and a couple of options so your procurement team can choose the workflow that matches ERP constraints.

PO fields and mapping (we can accept these as discrete fields on the PO or as metadata in the invoice):
- PO number: required
- bill_to name / remit_to address: required
- BU code / cost center: strongly recommended (maps to our ledger tags)
- Line-item SKU: optional — we can invoice at SKU granularity or as a single line referencing the blanket PO

Invoice cadence options:
- Monthly invoices against a single blanket PO (preferred for most enterprise customers)
- Weekly or per-billing-event invoices are supported if your AR team requires it

Net terms flexibility and commercial options:
- Standard hosted API terms: Net30 (default), with Net45/Net60 on approved procurement paperwork for enterprise deals
- Discount options for upfront/committed commitments (examples):
  * 4% for annual prepay at $100k+
  * 6% for annual prepay at $250k+
  * 8% for annual prepay at $500k+ or multi-year commitment
- If you prefer monthly invoicing (no prepay), we can provide a smaller committed discount (typically 2–3% depending on volume and term)

Attachments: I’m sending our invoice sample and the discount grid so you can slot numbers into your sourcing system.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether you want a single blanket PO and monthly invoices or prepay with a single invoice for the year.
2) If you want the deeper discount tiers, we’ll route a pricing exception through our revenue ops team (cc-ing Ben and Vanessa).
3) I can schedule a 30-min call with your procurement and our billing folks if helpful.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.csv, discount-grid.pdf

Thanks Priya — that helps. We’d like to move forward with the following:

- Single blanket PO referencing multiple invoice line-items (our ERP maps BU code on the PO header)
- Monthly invoices (month-end) against the blanket PO
- Preference is Net45 terms
- We’re exploring an annual prepay but need to see the exact numbers to evaluate cashflow impact. Can you confirm the 6% example for $250k prepay in terms of final invoice/rebate mechanics?

I attached the PO template. After you confirm mechanics for the prepay rebate, I’ll circulate internally. We can schedule a 20-min connect tomorrow if you have time.

Elena

Priya — quick take from sales: we can approve a 6% prepay rebate at $250k for GreenArc given scope and strategic fit, subject to finance sign-off on cash recognition. Standard approach we use: one-time credit applied on the initial invoice and then invoice the remainder monthly at net amount (we document rebate on the SOW/Invoice footer). If finance wants amortization, we can do monthly credit entries instead.

Vanessa — can you confirm whether our AR team needs the BU code in a particular format? Also flag any PO header validations that must exist before routing to collection.

Ben
VP, Enterprise Sales
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: PO field mapping, net terms & conditional discount request

Quick from billing ops: we can accept monthly invoices against a blanket PO. Requirements:
- PO header must include: PO number, bill_to name, remit_to address, BU code (format: BU-XXXX, 4 digits)
- Remit_to needs to match the company legal name on the PO or we’ll need an instruction letter from AP
- For the 6% prepay rebate at $250k: finance prefers a one-time credit on the initial invoice and then monthly billing at the net amount; they will accept amortization only if GreenArc provides a prepayment receipt and the deal gets finance approval (timing may add 5–7 business days).

Action: Priya — if GreenArc signs up for the prepay, ask them to include the prepayment line on the PO (amount and remit instructions) so AR can reconcile automatically.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience and the PO template. Quick summary and confirmation:

- We can accept a single blanket PO with monthly month-end invoices against it.
- Net45 is acceptable and we will note that on the SOW.
- Prepay rebate mechanics (approved): 6% one-time credit for a $250k+ 12-month prepay. That credit will appear as a single line item on the initial invoice; monthly invoices thereafter will be for the net amount. Finance has to receive the prepayment receipt to reconcile the credit.

Please include the following on your PO to ensure automatic routing: PO number, bill_to, remit_to, BU code (format BU-XXXX). If you want the prepay rebate, please add a prepayment line with the amount and remit instructions.

If helpful, I can send a short template language for the PO and a redlined SOW reflecting the rebate. Do you have time for a 20-min call Monday to finalize?

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
